posts.text:
Gavin Newsom has lost a lot of ground in Democratic primary polls.

It's maybe not any one thing, though Ossoff isn't helping. Conspicuously embracing Biden is a weird choice too.

More fundamentally, he's the avatar of a Democratic establishment that voters want to move beyond.
